assignment: Advise a park board whether the survey supports changing winter access. Propose a proportionate next survey.
source: Observers counted 48 birds over 12 hours in the east marsh and 30 over five hours in the west. East visits were mostly windy afternoons. West visits were calm mornings. Visitor traffic was measured only in the east. Two east trails may be closed at a cost to neighboring residents.

criteria.full: Computes four and six sightings per observer-hour and distinguishes sightings from population sizes.
criteria.partial: Adjusts for effort in words or computes only one rate.

criteria.full: Explains how timing, wind and missing west traffic prevent a causal visitor-effect conclusion.
criteria.partial: Names a confounder without linking it to the inference.

criteria.full: Proposes matched times and weather or repeated strata, equalized effort, and traffic counts in both marshes.
criteria.partial: Suggests additional counts without comparable exposure.

criteria.full: Offers a reversible access decision, with a specific board review criterion and a resident impact consideration.
criteria.partial: Calls for caution without a decision or review rule.
